stem: In paragraph 4, why does the author use the figurative phrase “the eyes that peered out into the universe” to describe the telescopes?

options.label: A
options.text: To suggest that telescopes are used to locate and watch over distant objects in space

options.label: B
options.text: To indicate that telescopes are used for watching certain people

options.label: C
options.text: To show that telescopes are delicate objects that need a lot of care and attention

options.label: D
options.text: To explain that telescopes should be used only by professional scientists
